question: 设 $z=f(x,y)$ 有连续偏导数，且 $f(x,x^2)=1$，$f_x'(1,1)=2$，则 $$\lim_{x\to 0} [f(\cos x,\sqrt{1+x^2})]^{\frac{1}{\ln(1+x^2)}} = \underline{\qquad\qquad}$$
raw_question_text: 设 $z=f(x,y)$ 有连续偏导数，且 $f(x,x^2)=1$，$f_x'(1,1)=2$，则 $$\lim_{x\to 0} [f(\cos x,\sqrt{1+x^2})]^{\frac{1}{\ln(1+x^2)}} = \underline{\qquad\qquad}$$
